summary: Comprehensive testing of merged Karachi Naseeb platform (OLD POS + NEW customer site). Backend: 37/37 pytest tests passing covering all critical OLD POS endpoints (auth, categories, menu-items, POS orders, inventory, expenses, vendors+transactions+payments, refunds, X/Z reports, dashboard, settings, voice/whatsapp/schedule/tunnel statuses) AND all critical NEW endpoints (public restaurant-info, public menu, customer register/login/me, online-orders place+track+admin-list+pending-count, offers list+admin CRUD, reviews public list, event-bookings, auth guards). Frontend: customer site (/, /menu, /login) renders perfectly; staff login at /admin/staff-login authenticates with admin@restaurant.com/admin123 and redirects to /admin/dashboard-classic; AdminLayout sidebar correctly shows BOTH 'ONLINE STORE' and 'POS OPERATIONS' sections; ALL 11 legacy POS pages (/admin/pos, /dashboard-classic, /menu-mgmt, /inventory, /vendors, /expenses, /refunds, /old-orders, /reports, /settings-full) render proper content under the merged AdminLayout. ONE issue: /admin/dashboard (the NEW online-store admin dashboard) renders a blank white page.

ui_bugs.issue: Page renders completely blank — no header, no stats, no content. Body innerText contains only 'Made with Emergent' badge. All other admin routes work fine, suggesting the AdminDashboardPage component itself is broken (likely a rendering error, missing import, or unhandled error before AdminLayout mounts). Check console for runtime error.

action_items: Investigate why /admin/dashboard (NEW online-store admin dashboard component) renders blank — likely a JS runtime error in AdminDashboardPage.jsx. Check browser console; verify imports, hooks, and that data fetches handle errors gracefully. All other admin pages mount correctly under AdminLayout, so the issue is isolated to the AdminDashboardPage component.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 3326 lines monolithic — should be split into routers (auth, pos, online_orders, vendors, reports, settings, public) for maintainability.

Public /api/menu returns {categories, items} dict shape but backend tests/POS endpoints use list of items — mild schema inconsistency between public and admin menu endpoints (works but adds confusion).
Two parallel auth contexts (knb_token customer, staff_auth_token staff) coexist correctly; AdminLayout's dual-token acceptance was verified working.
FastAPI request validation runs before auth dependency, so unauth POST with empty/invalid body returns 422 instead of 401 — minor but predictable behavior.

success_rate.frontend: 92% (12/13 admin routes load; customer flow works)

rca of the issue: Issue: /admin/dashboard renders blank. Reproduction: log in at /admin/staff-login as admin@restaurant.com/admin123 → click 'Dashboard' under ONLINE STORE in sidebar (or visit /admin/dashboard directly). Result: completely blank page (only floating 'Made with Emergent' badge visible; sidebar+header DOM not rendered). All sibling /admin/* routes render correctly with sidebar, so the failure is inside the AdminDashboardPage component (most likely thrown error before AdminLayout's <Outlet/> children render, OR the route is mapped to a component that returns null/throws). Mitigation: open the page with browser devtools console open to capture the exact error; inspect /app/frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminDashboardPage.jsx (or whichever component is mapped to the /admin/dashboard route in App.js) for runtime errors, missing API endpoints, or unhandled promise rejections.
